scope: Reconcile prior diagnostic build hypotheses with explicit project properties. This does not prove historical release provenance or admit a B2 reference.

default_real.PREP01: 8-byte default REAL was a strongly supported hypothesis with candidate Windows options
default_real.new_evidence: RealKIND=realKIND8 in all four Intel project configurations

local_storage.PREP01: Intel default local-storage semantics was the baseline; /Qsave treated as sensitivity only
local_storage.new_evidence: LocalVariableStorage=localStorageSave in all four Intel project configurations
local_storage.consequence: The GNU diagnostic use of -fno-automatic is more directly aligned with the recovered project contract than PREP01 could previously establish.

unformatted_io.PREP01: PowerStation-compatible framing was very strongly supported and /fpscomp:ioformat was a candidate option
unformatted_io.new_evidence: FPS4IOFormat=true in all four project configurations

runtime_checks.new_evidence: Traceback=true and BoundsCheck=true in all configurations; Debug configurations explicitly enable debug information; Debug|x64 enables LocalSavedScalarsZero=true

source_selection.new_evidence: 58 project Fortran units; all are present in B0; B0 alternates input1_1.for and Outselorg.for are not selected; received executable embeds the same 58 source names and no alternate paths

linker_and_runtime.PREP01: linker settings and runtime libraries unknown
linker_and_runtime.new_evidence: Project supplies console subsystem, animo41.exe output name, kernel32.lib dependency, debug/release incremental-link policy; Debug configurations name the multithreaded debug Fortran runtime. Received executable imports only KERNEL32.dll and imagehlp.dll and embeds Intel Fortran RTL strings.

optimization.new_evidence: Debug configurations explicitly set optimizeDisabled; Release configurations do not carry an explicit Optimization attribute in the supplied project
optimization.received_executable_relation: PDB path strongly supports x64 Debug, therefore optimizeDisabled for this received 2026 rebuild

double_precision.PREP01: GNU diagnostic forced 8-byte DOUBLE PRECISION semantics with -fdefault-double-8
double_precision.new_evidence: Project exposes RealKIND=realKIND8 but no separate DOUBLE PRECISION property was identified in the supplied project XML
double_precision.warning: Do not infer exact DOUBLE PRECISION width from the project property alone without verifying Intel project-property semantics.
